intent: Seven independent low-frequency base images composed under the separate existing Boss pattern textures; not tinted or transformed duplicates.

themes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: an original low-frequency base texture for a vertically scrolling Japanese bullet-hell Boss spell-card background; a separate decorative pattern will later move over this image at runtime. Square 1024x1024 opaque raster. This is ONLY the quiet underlying field, not a finished background composite. Abstract painted and print-textured color fields with large flowing shapes and subtle depth, reminiscent of surreal hand-made Japanese game spell backgrounds. Wide broad strokes, irregular organic rhythm, dark midtones with limited muted accents. Full bleed, seamless visual coverage to all edges, no frame, no scene perspective, no buildings, no people, no readable writing, no glyphs, no mandala, no stars, no tiny repeated decorative patterns, no bright white points that could look like bullets. Rich restrained texture, no photorealistic shiny 3D or vector wireframe. Keep the whole image suited behind dense bright projectiles. Theme: stolen lamplight and an unclaimed doorway. A vast smoky field of dark burnt sienna, deep oxblood, and almost-black indigo, broad amber ink washes curling inward like dim fire reflected through layered handmade paper. A few broad copper glows dissolve softly into shadows; no flower or geometric seal motifs. Composition diagonal sweeping sheets of vapor, no centered focal emblem.
